english.title: Proprietor of hackney carriage / PVH fail to report accident affecting comfort of passenger - inside Greater London
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the proprietor of

(A)_[a hackney carriage]_
(B)_[a private hire vehicle]_

namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), licensed by **(..SPECIFY DISTRICT COUNCIL..), failed without reasonable excuse to report to the district council as soon as reasonably practicable and in any case within seventy-two hours of the occurrence, an accident to the vehicle causing damage materially affecting the safety, performance or appearance of the vehicle or the comfort or convenience of persons carried in the vehicle
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 50(3) and (5) and 76 Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1976.
